title: Complete 3D Projection Gizmo
description: Rebuild the ad-hoc corner orbit gizmo into a complete projection navigation control: face/corner/center cube emitting WorldProjectionSpec, plus a family switcher exposing every taxonomy kind, with fixed snap pipeline so all transitions land correctly.
summary: Split projection chrome vs gizmo: pane selects mode (kinds + Iso/Di/Tri, Cab/Cav/Mil, Fish/Pan); cube only refines angle within the active mode and no longer switches kind. Removed duplicated ortho views and one-point axes from the mode row. vitest 126 passed.
